# dsh-shortcut-extensions · 快捷键拓展
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds a keyboard-driven quick-switching layer to the DSH web/des
ktop UI: a model palette, a session palette with prompt preview, session cycling, find-next-answered
, composer focus, and configurable permission cycling — all manageable from a sidebar control panel.

中文说明见 README.zh.md。
- **Header chips** — the current workspace name and git branch sit right beside
the session title (`conversation.session.header.actions`); the branch is re-read whenever you enter

a session.
- **Skill palette** (⌘⇧K) — lists installed skills from `skills/list` and inserts `/name

` at the caret without touching the rest of your draft.
- The workspace and git-branch chips use a s
table per-name hue (colored tags).
## Features
- **Model palette** (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+M`) — fuzzy search; AntD-style colored provider tags (click a t
ag to filter that provider); name-suffix tags (e.g. `routing group`); reasoning badges; pin favorite

s to the top.
- **Session palette** (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S`) — two-column layout: sessions on the left,
your own prompts preview on the right (follows the highlighted row, debounced + cached). Includes ar

chived sessions with badges; Enter opens and auto-restores archived ones.
- **Session cycling** (`Ct

rl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab`, desktop) — cycle in the sidebar's recency order.
- **Find next answered
session** (`Cmd/Ctrl+G`, web `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G`) — jumps to the most recently answered not-yet-viewe

d session; falls back to sessions that are still running.
- **Focus composer** (`Cmd/Ctrl+I`) — rest

ores caret position via the host composer facade.
- **Permission cycling** (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P`) — cy
cles through the presets you configure (any 2+ of Read Only / Workspace Write / Full access, plus an

y deployment-specific presets), expandable in the panel.
- **Sidebar control panel** — every command
with live keycaps and an on/off switch; a **shortcut reference tab** listing every host command, wi

th device-local rebind/reset; transient hint banner so no command fails silently.
- **IME-safe** — k
ey handling ignores IME composition state (pressing Enter to commit candidates never accidentally se

lects an item).
- Theme-aware (light/dark), fixed-height palettes (no jumping while searching).
## Default shortcuts (macOS desktop; Ctrl on Windows/Linux)
| Command | Keys |

| Model palette | ⌘⇧M |
| Session palette | ⌘⇧S |
| Permission cycle | ⌘⇧P |
| Find next answered se

ssion | ⌘G (web: ⌘⇧G) |
| Focus composer | ⌘I (web: ⌘⌥I) |
| Next / previous session | ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab

sion | ⌘G (web: ⌘⇧G) |
| Focus composer | ⌘I (web: ⌘⌥I) |
| Next / previous session | ⌃Tab / ⌃⇧Tab |
Every command can be rebound in **DSH Settings → Shortcuts** or in the panel's reference tab; overri
des are device-local.
## Install

1. Clone this repository.
2. In DSH, open **插件 (Plugins)** and install the plugin from the cloned di

rectory.
3. Reload the window (Cmd+R).
Requires a standard DSH web composition. Optional host capabilities degrade gracefully: without perm
ission presets the permission surfaces hide; without the turn-outline projection the prompt preview
the permission surfaces hide; without the turn-outline projection the prompt preview shows a notice.
## Notes & limitations
- Browsers reserve some keys: single-modifier bindings like `Cmd+G` are desktop-only, and `Cmd+Shift

+P` is taken by Firefox (private window).
- In the desktop app, `Cmd+W` belongs to the native "close

window" menu item and cannot be taken over by plugins.
- Keybinding overrides are stored per device
(desktop: `userData/keybindings.json`; web: origin-local storage).
